added.name: Bar Henrietta
added.vibes: Kind of the perfect bar (vino and non vino). It's not going to be like wow this was the best drink or best bite of food I have ever had but you will go and be like umm this is kind of perfect. No res but there are a lot of other spots you can wait at around the area

added.name: Big in Japan
added.vibes: Kind of a speakeasy but not really with almost this Tetris like bar seating. It's actually really nice in there. Drinks are v good and lighting is ideal

added.name: Larrys
added.vibes: Everything you want out of a restaurant (or in life tbh). Very neighborhood feel with a lunch scene that is just as good as the dinner scene. Very casual but they really don't play about anything. Man I love this place

added.name: Stem Bar
added.vibes: I get upset that I can't have this place as much as I want to (Montreal syndrome??). First come first served bar / resto that does not play. Their food is amazing, the scene is amazing (more of a date or buttoned up type) and the dessert is stupido

added.name: Contramar
added.vibes: Usually when a spot is soo hyped and popular it really isn't that good at all. Contramar does not fit that pattern - undeniable food, really nothing more to say... please go. Honorable mention to the desserts (fig ting is brazy)

added.name: Salle Climatisée
added.vibes: Woah. Perfect scene, perfect menu, everything is on a million here (they also have a great website). Not super whitecloth but a biiiit on that side. Good celebration, date or treat yourself spot

added.name: Fleurs et Cadeaux
added.vibes: A literal flower shop that also has one of the most banging Japanese restaurants I've had. My favorite plating of any spot I have ever been to... I wanted to steal their wine glasses... I did not (sadly). Staff is also really amazing. Weirdly they have a club downstairs (never been but interesting)
moves: Just run it up brev - really good specials as well

added.name: Fugaz
added.vibes: Kind of feels like a cool kid spot in CDMX. The staff is laid back and all wearing vintage clothes. Don't get it wrong though, they take the food seriously and it's great. Good date spot

added.name: Oropel
added.vibes: The perfect bar. Extensive outdoor seating with a cozy inside. Lots of locals and regulars but will get the occasional tourists (but the cool ones). Kind of place that you stay at for a long sip and yap situ

added.name: Los Parados
added.vibes: Yes yes yes (one for each taco). Quick ting, eat standing, very run up and gun up

added.name: Pujol
added.vibes: In such a competitive city for food and decor, Pujol has managed to stand out in basically every aspect. I can't get over how beautiful the scene is there (food is also a banger). Pls go here maane

added.name: Rosetta
added.vibes: I love a courtyard and this restaurant has one of the most beautiful ones. Everything is done in good taste here (their plates are really nice). Food is very good. More fancy but a really perfect lunch scene for sure

added.name: El Xampanyet
added.vibes: Honestly, one of my favorite meal moments I have had in my life. I feel like this spot embodies the spirit of Barcelona. Tight, buzzing, loud (in all the right ways) and the food keeps on coming. I don't think they have a menu, p sure you just run it up. First come first served and you wait in line soooooo

added.name: Le Vin Papillon
added.vibes: I was working a lot (like a lot a lot) when I was in Montreal and this became my local dissociation by indulgence spot. Everything hits here. Perfect lighting, really good food and obvi the menu is on a big chalk board. I would fight one of you for the carrot cake right now

added.name: Albi
added.vibes: Albi means heart in Arabic and this spot has my heart brev. It's refreshing to see Palestinian food taken a bit fancy. All the familiar flavours but ~elevated~. I bang with it

added.name: Maydan
added.vibes: Any restaurant that cooks on a live fire I immediately love and this spot has the fire pit right in the middle (kind of incredible). That sets the tone for the meal and nothing misses from there. Good food, buzzy and drinks are greeeat. Go to their bar Madina when you're done with dinner
moves: Honestly run up the tawleh thing

added.name: La Panadería Cali
added.vibes: Best juice ever. A great invitation to Cali, Colombia; full of color and passion. This place is a piece of my heart. Everything here is made with/from/by/for love
